title: Q-GAP-site-agent-protocol-parity: The platform site answers MCP and A2A the way the kit now does
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'grep:site/agentic.js::-32022'
**Prediction:** market_open_gaps <= 5 within 720 h
**Status:** closed

Gap in component `agents-roles`: The platform site answers MCP and A2A the way the kit now does. The kit answers an unsupported MCP version with UnsupportedProtocolVersionError (-32022) and serves an A2A 1.0 card without legacy fields; site/agentic.js still answers -32600 and its card carries the 0.3 fields url, preferredTransport and additionalInterfaces. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1). The proof is `grep:site/agentic.js::-32022`, shipped with a test.

**Out of scope:** any other gap in the register, and a proof file with no behaviour and no test behind it.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'grep:site/agentic.js::-32022'

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:10:18Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
